title: 9 R.I.P. sequel Visual Novel's Trailer Reveals October 27 Release in West
content: Idea Factory International began streaming on Tuesday a promotional trailer for the supernatural visual novel 9 R.I.P. sequel , and it reveals that the game will launch physically and digitally in the West for Nintendo Switch on October 27.
author: ANN

title: One Piece Just Kicked Off the Beginning of Its End With Elbaph Arc Twist
content: One Piece is now in the midst of the climax for the Elbaph Arc, but its latest chapter has a new reveal that has kicked off the beginning of the end. One Piece officially began the Final Saga of Eiichiro Oda’s manga run a few years ago , and it was confirmed that the long running series was now in the final stretch…
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle is Finally Streaming With Crunchyroll After Very Long Wait
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle has officially made its streaming debut a year after the film first hit theaters in Japan, and now it’s time to check it out with Crunchyroll.

title: A Baki The Grappler Isekai Has Been Announced For 2027
content: The Baki franchise has become one of the biggest anime exclusives for Netflix, with the son of the Ogre recently finishing his fight against a mythical samurai who was brought back from the grave.

title: An Official One Piece/Spongebob SquarePants Crossover Has Been Announced
content: Anime crossovers are nothing new for the medium, with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates having plenty of anime crossovers of their own. In one instance, the Straw Hats teamed up with Dragon Ball’s Z-Fighters to tackle some wild challenges, though this next crossover is unlike anything we’ve seen before.

title: Star Wars Spinoff’s Season 2 Talks Revealed By Showrunner Ahead of Next Week’s Release
content: Next week, Star Wars will return with a whole new series – The Ninth Jedi . Spinning out of the Star Wars: Visions anthology, The Ninth Jedi is set in a distant future where the Jedi are believed extinct.

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime Reveals Key Visual, Trailer
